controls.name: set-server-id
controls.description: Set the server ID for load balancing. (internal call)

controls.name: bind-interface
controls.description: Bind the server to a specific network interface. (L4LB and Popcache only)

controls.name: update-mtu
controls.description: Update the MTU (Maximum Transmission Unit) size for network packets. (L4LB only)

controls.name: set-cert-path
controls.description: Set the path to the TLS/SSL certificate file. (Popcache only)

controls.name: set-key-path
controls.description: Set the path to the TLS/SSL key file. (Popcache only)

controls.name: reload-tls-cert
controls.description: Reload the TLS/SSL certificate and key from the specified file paths.

controls.name: set-http-port
controls.description: Set the HTTP port number for the server. (Popcache only)

controls.name: set-https-port
controls.description: Set the HTTPS port number for the server. (Popcache only)

controls.name: set-http3-port
controls.description: Set the HTTP/3 port number for the server. (Popcache only)

controls.name: set-qlog-enabled
controls.description: Enable or disable QUIC logging (qlog). (Popcache only)

controls.name: set-origin
controls.description: Set the origin server. (Popcache only)

controls.name: challenge-dns
controls.description: Handle ACME DNS-01 challenge for domain validation. (DNS only)

controls.name: cleanup-dns
controls.description: Clean up ACME DNS-01 challenge records after validation. (DNS only)

controls.name: set-dns-port
controls.description: Set the DNS port number for the server. (DNS only)

controls.name: set-dns-domain
controls.description: Set the DNS domain name for the server. (DNS only)

controls.name: set-dns-mail
controls.description: Set the DNS mail address for the server. (DNS only)

controls.name: set-dns-api-token
controls.description: Set the API token for external DNS server management. (DNS only)

controls.name: set-dns-api-zone-id
controls.description: Set the API zone ID for external DNS server management. (DNS only)

controls.name: set-router-hostname
controls.description: Set the hostname of the router. (Router only)

controls.name: set-router-username
controls.description: Set the username for router authentication. (Router only)

controls.name: set-router-password
controls.description: Set the password for router authentication. (Router only)

controls.name: reset-dns-acme
controls.description: Reset all ACME DNS-01 challenge records. (DNS only)

controls.name: init
controls.description: Initialize the application-specific agent.
